facts.statement: Fossils of Artzosuchus were discovered at the Üüden Sair locality within the Djadochta Formation in Mongolia.
facts.quote: Specimens have been found from the Üüden Sair locality of the Djadochta Formation in Mongolia

facts.statement: Artzosuchus lived during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: date back to the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous

facts.statement: The specific classification of Artzosuchus beyond being a basal crocodylomorph remains indeterminate due to the fragmentary nature of the fossil material.
facts.quote: Its classification beyond that of a basal crocodylomorph is indeterminant because of the fragmentary nature of the material associated with the genus

facts.statement: Artzosuchus belongs to the family Artzosuchidae.
Artzosuchus lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: The genus Artzosuchus was described by Efimov in 1983.
Artzosuchus is a monospecific genus that contains only the single species Artzosuchus brachicephalus.
facts.quote: It is a monospecific genus containing only one species, Artzosuchus brachicephalus
